instruction: Create a Python command-line program called number_magic.py. The program should accept a positive integer from the user and perform several interesting calculations on it: determine whether it is prime, calculate its factorial, generate its Fibonacci sequence up to that number, calculate the sum of all integers from 1 through the number, and determine all positive divisors of the number. Present the results in a clean, readable format. Include input validation and handle invalid input gracefully. Organize the code into separate functions so each calculation can be tested independently.
